action.title: How the Black Friday deal works

timeline.firstStepText: Find flights with the 'Black Friday' label
timeline.secondStepText: Book your flight – the deal is automatically applied
timeline.thirdStepText: Enjoy your savings, enjoy your trip!

content.text: Applies on select flights with the 'Black Friday' label
Applies to select destinations in Canada, Mexico, USA, Africa, Asia, Europe and South America.

The Black Friday deal amount is paid by Booking.com on your behalf. Prices may change during the campaign period. Booking.com reserves the right to stop the Black Friday Deals promotion earlier in case the total financial value of the promotional offers already redeemed exceeds a certain financial value.
